blocks.h2: Water Heaters in Hanover Park Homes
blocks.intro: Most Hanover Park water heaters sit in a basement or utility room.

items.body: Tight spaces need careful planning for repairs and replacements.
The village gets treated Lake Michigan water, which is easier on heaters than well water.
Many newer installs use a fan to vent, which adds parts that can fail.

bodies: We repair gas and electric tank heaters, power-vent units and tankless heaters in Hanover Park homes.
Read us the label when you call. If it's time for a new one, see [water heater replacement](/hanover-park/water-heater-installation).
A yearly flush clears sediment and helps the heater last. We test the relief valve, check the anode rod and inspect the burner and venting.
Tankless heaters need descaling on a schedule.

blocks.h2: What Happens When You Call J. Blanton

steps.body: When the heater is near the end.

img.alt: J. Blanton plumber in shoe covers on a home's front steps with a sewer camera

blocks.body: Most water heater repairs come down to a few parts. On gas heaters, it's the thermocouple or flame sensor, the igniter, the gas control valve or, on power-vent models, the fan and pressure switch. On electric heaters, it's usually a heating element or a thermostat. Relief valves can drip as they age. These are all replaceable. What can't be fixed is the tank itself. Once the tank leaks, the fix is a new heater.

blocks.h2: Water Heater Questions From Hanover Park Homeowners

items.q: Is it worth repairing an older heater?
items.preview: Under 8 years, usually. Over 12, usually not.
items.answer: Under about 8 years, a repair usually makes sense. Past 12 or with a tank leak, replace it.

items.q: Why is there water around my heater?
items.preview: A valve, fitting or the tank.
items.answer: It could be the relief valve, a fitting or the tank itself. A leaking tank means replacement.

items.q: My power-vent heater won't start. Why?
items.preview: Often the fan or a pressure switch.
items.answer: Often the vent fan, a pressure switch or a blocked vent pipe.

items.q: How long do water heaters last?
Can I relight the pilot myself?
items.answer: Often, yes. Follow the instructions on the label. If it won't stay lit, call us.
